body:
Prior to this experience, I had been depressed, and was also rather bored and frustrated
With life. After much research into the safety of Vicodin, I decided on 20mg as my dose.
I had eaten a full meal one hour before. I am also taking 20mg Prozac, and 5mg Zyprexa for
Depression/bipolar disorder. The setting for this experience was alone at home.
6:50 pm - Ingested 4 5mg hydrocodone/500mg apap pills. I put on some music and wait for
effects to begin.
7:20 pm - Not really 'high' just yet, but sensing the beginning of an opiate buzz.
I feel warm all over, happy, and content.
8:00 pm - The real euphoria begins, watching Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas.
8:20 pm - I'm higher than I've ever been, but I think I could still hold it together if I
had to deal with authority figures for some reason.
9:00 pm - There is a tingling sensation in my face, and every activity is pure pleasure,
I feel great walking around, or just sitting quietly. Music is awesome.
9:45 pm - Ingested 5mg Zyprexa. Things seem to have leveled off a bit.
11:00 pm - Definitely coming down, and itching like crazy. Strangely, I don't really care
about the itching too much.
After a full night's sleep, there was no hangover whatsoever, I even felt a little better than normal. I have a new favorite drug.
